items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: when this fellow called Red Knight was there and heard her tell him about what had happened with John Bubbles

ctx.x: So the piano player, he could understand English, but he was German, he didn't say a word about nothin' he kept neutral, okay. I told her she could verify it by him. He didn't

verify it. But when this fellow called Red Knight was there and heard her tell him about what had happened with John Bubbles -- he stood her down because they were her guests, this Red Knight was her guest there and when they got through telling her about me and she went and told all the rest of them, 'Look, if I hear anything about John Bubbles again, I'm going to cancel the entire show and I'm going to get you off the bases, you're not going to play the base no more.'
So, man, they were scared to breathe where I was concerned the next time I went out on the show.

items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: People like Redd Foxx wouldn't have been received in the theaters in those days because he has a dirty act.

ctx.x: Same as Noble Sissle, I figured he could make more money with his band than he could with his partner, but he didn't. In my estimation he didn't. He went to the dogs it seemed to me after that, but God rest his soul, he was all right.

But that's the way life goes. Who's going to know how to do life -- nobody. So you see, George, when you talk about show business I'm thinking -- see, what hurts me more or less about this business is I was in it so long and made it clean for the negro with entertainment that the negro was received. People like Redd Foxx wouldn't have been received in the theaters in those days because he has a dirty act. They wouldn't book him. And neither would they book what's-his-name? Richard Pryor? Him, neither. And most of…
